skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

version.changelog: Refresh ClawHub mirror to match current SkillHub workflow.

llm.summary: The skill is read-only and purpose-aligned, but it runs an unpinned npm package at runtime with access to the user's API key, so it should be reviewed before installation.

dimensions.detail: Node/npm and SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY are coherent for the integration, but live-resolving and executing a mutable npm package gives that package the agent process environment and local execution authority beyond the narrow read-only API task.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The runtime examples use npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest and the install metadata names socialdatax-skills without a pinned version, so the executed package can change after review and installation confirmation is bypassed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are mostly scoped to user-provided note IDs or links and returned comments, with user-controlled pagination options including an unbounded --all mode that could increase API usage.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact shows no background service, scheduled task, memory write, browser profile access, or privilege escalation; the main privilege concern is transient execution of the npm package with inherited environment access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is XHS comment and reply retrieval followed by comment insight summaries; the commands and MCP tool names match that purpose and the skill says it does not log in, post, like, comment, or modify accounts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable running the current npm release of socialdatax-skills with your SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY. Prefer a pinned reviewed version, minimal environment variables, and a sandboxed or containerized run before using it on sensitive projects.
llm.findings:
[RP1] unexpected: Accepted as a real supply-chain concern because the artifact repeatedly instructs npx execution of socialdatax-skills@latest; this does not prove malicious behavior, but it leaves reviewed behavior mutable.
[T08] unexpected: Accepted in context: the skill's unpinned npm execution is not necessary to the comment-analysis purpose and should be pinned or otherwise contained before normal installation.
